queries.sql: SELECT a.*, e.title AS event_title, e.event_date, e.abstract_deadline, e.abstract_submission_active, k.nama_kategori, COALESCE((SELECT COUNT(*) FROM review r WHERE r.id_abstrak = a.id_abstrak),0) AS review_count FROM "abstrak" "a" LEFT JOIN "events" "e" ON "e"."id" = "a"."event_id" LEFT JOIN "kategori_abstrak" "k" ON "k"."id_kategori" = "a"."id_kategori" WHERE "a"."id_user" = 5 ORDER BY "a"."tanggal_upload" DESC
